meta_description: Prominence 30A pet friendly rental, Rays for Days, located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Pet Friendly, Golf Cart and 4 Bikes
description_expanded: Description Description Prominence 30A pet friendly rental, Rays for Days, located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Pet Friendly, Golf Cart and 4 Bikes Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! LEARN MORE ABOUT THE PROMINENCE ON 30A NEIGHBORHOOD Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 3 Bedroom - Pet Friendly - 30A* 4 Seater Golf Cart* Living Area with Plenty of Seating and Large TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, TV* Bathroom 2 - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 3 - Bunk (Twin/Twin/Twin Trundle)* Living Area - Queen Sleeper Sofa* Half Bathroom on Main Level* Full-Size Washer/Dryer* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Garage* Sleeps 9 30A Beach Access Points PARKING - 2 Parking Spots Only - No parking is allowed on the street in front of the house or on any street within the neighborhood per the Prominence HOA.PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONS*** We welcome well trained dogs up to 25 lbs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. ADDITIONAL PET FEE APPLIES & IS COLLECTED AFTER BOOKING IS MADE. About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, FloridaProminence is one of the most popular communities on 30A and features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Prominence is perfectly located to new and long time 30A haunts as well as the beautiful white beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests will enjoy a beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools.Located at the town center, the Big Chill is a hot-spot for entertainment and features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights on the green. Concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops are just some of the things to do within a less than 5 minute walk. Prominence is centrally located on 30A between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to the east.COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIESWalking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops, Nightly EntertainmentCigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place Onsite Ice MachineKids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub2 Large Community Pool(s) with Zero Entry (no steps) – perfect for the elderly and toddlersBarbecue AreasProximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside5 miles to nearest Grocery Store***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct)Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally.Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities.INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less
